description: This is a shell script providing utility functions and configurations for an OpenWrt-based system. It includes functions for configuration management, user and group management, system information, and package post-installation tasks.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages if the DEBUG variable is set.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on multiple hex values of the same length.

methods.name: data_2bin
methods.description: Converts a hex string to its binary representation.

methods.name: data_2xor_val
methods.description: Computes XOR values from hex data.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends a value to a variable with optional separator.

methods.name: list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string is present in a list stored in a variable.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration, possibly from UCI system.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets callback functions to no-op.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Placeholder function, returns 0.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Defines a new configuration section.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list configuration.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts string value to boolean (1/0).

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a given type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list items in a configuration section.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Performs pre-removal cleanup tasks for a package.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Adds system groups and users based on package info.

methods.name: update_alternatives
methods.description: Manages system alternatives for package files.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Performs post-installation tasks for a package.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Sources all .sh files from a directory.

methods.name: ipcalc
methods.description: Wraps ipcalc.sh to compute network parameters.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds MTD partition index by name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Finds MTD device path by partition name.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds MMC device by partition name.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a group with specified GID.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds next available GID for a group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Adds a user with specific UID and GID.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Retrieves the system's board name.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Extracts a variable value from kernel command line.
